entries.mechanism: EUROMOD BE_2025 bwkrg_be pays its older 600 EUR annual maximum with no 2025 fixed top-up. The Flemish implementing order consolidated as of 1 January 2025 sets a 650 EUR maximum plus a 50 EUR fixed top-up when payable, which is what the source-backed RuleSpec returns for the full-time low-wage band.

The half-time low-wage case scales the same stale schedule: the 2025 order scales the 650 EUR maximum by the 0.5 work fraction and adds the unscaled 50 EUR fixed top-up, while EUROMOD scales its older 600 EUR maximum and pays no top-up.

In the degressive band EUROMOD BE_2025 uses the older 1,800/2,500 EUR monthly wage thresholds, 600 EUR maximum, 20 EUR small-payment threshold, and no floor or top-up, against the 2025 order's 2,115/3,114.99 EUR thresholds, 650 EUR maximum, 50 EUR floor, and 50 EUR top-up. After bridging EUROMOD's yemeq_s into Axiom monthly gross, both upper-band residuals equal the same threshold, floor, and top-up gap filed upstream. The Brussels non-Flanders zero case and the tiny part-time suppression case match, isolating the residual to the stale amount schedule.
